testId: testim-migrated/tests/admin/sales-rep/sales-rep-user-association.spec.ts > Admin - Sales Rep > Z10-TC-23089 sales rep field resets when the user's store changes

scenario.summary: For a user on all stores, the admin assigns store A's sales rep on Manage User with store A selected, then changes the Store Name dropdown to another store; the Sales Rep field becomes blank and a different sales rep can be chosen.
steps: Go to Accounts and Users > Users; search the all-stores user (@user.userName) and click Manage.
With store A selected, assign the sales rep (@rep.fullName) through the popup.
Change the Store Name dropdown to another store.
stateChanges: The user is assigned to the sales rep for store A by the test (precondition done in the UI).
assertions: The Sales Rep field is blank after the store change
The Sales Rep search icon is available to assign a sales rep for the new store
evidence: Story Z10-28590 (Stabilize Sales Rep Workflow), data-needs analysis work/stories/Z10-28590/analysis.md section 2 and answers in section 6.
FSD 'Salesrep Assignment behaviour Under Manage User Screen' (user belongs to All Stores; changing the store blanks the Sales Rep field).
The test case's precondition (rep already assigned for store A) is done by the test in the UI: USER_ASSIGNED_TO_SALES_REP creates single-store users only.
User on all stores: USER_WEBSTORE_ALL_STORES (creates an All Stores user; replaces change proposal 7b, user answer 4), store MaxwellsHardware.
Store MaxwellsHardware: the store the migrated suites run on (store A).
Admin session: the suite's saved admin session (admin.setup.ts), a credential, not a need.
The test is skipped when the environment has the global setting AllowGlobalUserCreation off (user decision 2026-11-19): Znode creates a user for All Stores only when it is on (off on atstage).
